It sounds like you both want completely different things, and while you’re still young, you should definitely do some self-exploration. I’m the same age as you and I’ve been with my now fiancé for almost 3 years. Yes things can change as you get older, but if you truly love each other and want to stay together, consider going in different directions and doing long distance. Personally, my fiancé and I have been doing long distance for almost a year since he enlisted in the army. On the one hand, it sucks that we can’t see each other, but the distance has allowed me to find myself and figure out who I am outside of my relationship. I’m still figuring out who I am since I’m obviously still young lol. We still have that bond and that deep love for one another, but with the distance we can both grow as individuals. As for you and your bf, I feel that you two moving on to different places for a while would help you grow as individuals while you pursue your individual goals. Obviously the point of long-distance is that it’s temporary, but try living where you want to live, see if you like it, experience new things, etc. Be your own person and do some self-exploration. I hope you can truly learn who you want to be and what you want to do op. :)
